---
title: "Tools cutover packet"
description: "Worker identity, bindings, build, rollback and smoke checks for publishing the native Tools Worker."
updatedAt: "2026-11-09"
audience: developers
---

Tools (`apps/tools`) runs on TanStack Start, Vite+ and Void through the
[start bridge](/build/devops/start-bridge). Source needs no change to publish:
the emitted Worker builds and serves its mount, root and unknown paths in
workerd. Routes are never attached from config; the release operator attaches
them at cutover.

## Worker identity

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Worker | `tuturuuu-tools` (production profile), `tuturuuu-tools-vite-staging` (default) |
| Profile selector | `VITE_TOOLS_NATIVE_PROFILE=production` at build time |
| Hosts | `tools.tuturuuu.com`, `tools.tutur3u.com`, and the `tuturuuu.com/tools` mount; any other host is rejected |
| Compatibility | `nodejs_compat`, `global_fetch_strictly_public`; `workers_dev` and `preview_urls` off |
| Binding | `ASSETS` |
| Variables | `TUTURUUU_NOINDEX` (`0` in production), optional `INTERNAL_WEB_API_ORIGIN` (default `https://tuturuuu.com`) |
| Secrets (names) | `TUTURUUU_APP_COORDINATION_SECRET`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` |

`cloudflare/startup.mjs` refuses to serve when a secret is empty or when the
coordination secret is the development value.

## Build

```bash
bun turbo:local run build --filter='@tuturuuu/tools^...' --concurrency=2
bun run --silent scripts/ci/generate-build-metadata.ts
VITE_TOOLS_NATIVE_PROFILE=production bun run --cwd apps/tools build
CI=true CI_SOURCE_SHA=<sha> bun run --cwd apps/tools test:runtime
```

`tools-cloudflare.yaml` runs the same steps and seals the output with
`scripts/ci/tools-native-artifact.py` in its `cutover-artifact` job. Run the
build on a CI or remote runner, not a developer machine.

Tools has no `next/font` imports, so no font resolver parity work applies.

## Rollback

Remove or repoint the prepared Worker route, or restore the captured DNS, to
the last Vercel deployment. The `vercel-production-tools.yaml` publisher is
unchanged by the cutover. Route rollback does not touch data.

## Smoke checks

- `GET /` on the tools host answers `200` with an `X-Robots-Tag` header
- `/qr` and `/random` answer `200`
- `/api/build-info` answers `200` JSON with no-store caching
- `/robots.txt` answers `200`
- no `5xx` across the above
